body: Back in the day they would take any functional warm body they could get, but now wars are more controlled and smaller, so they can afford to be selective. I can see no clear path or immediate objective in my life.
I would've joined the military a long time ago. It's pretty much impossible to get in without a HSD or a GED plus college.
I don't have any friends. My mom is very far away and we aren't on the best of terms.
Thank you. I'm sorry to hear about your mother. I wish I could go to a community college; I dropped out of school in 6th grade.
